projects.title: MIT AOE Smart Campus Shuttle Tracker
projects.short_description: Real-time GPS tracking and occupancy monitor for MIT AOE campus shuttles between Alandi and Pune city.
projects.description: An IoT and web-based platform providing live GPS tracking, arrival time predictions, and seat availability for college buses. Designed to eliminate long waiting queues at Alandi depot and help students commute safely.
projects.problem_statement: Students and faculty face unpredictable transit timings and crowded shuttle buses between Alandi and Swargate/Pune Station without any real-time tracking system.
projects.proposed_solution: Deploy ESP32 GPS/cellular telemetry nodes on campus buses and connect them to a lightweight web dashboard that displays live vehicle locations, estimated arrival times, and passenger count.

projects.title: MIT AOE Campus Ride Share & Shuttle Tracker
projects.short_description: Live tracking, ETA forecasting, and carpool matching for students commuting to Alandi campus.
projects.description: A collaborative student mobility system that pairs real-time bus telemetry with peer carpooling routes. Eliminates congestion and makes travel safer for evening lab batches.
projects.problem_statement: Students face long waits at Alandi bus stand with zero visibility into bus schedules and arrival delays.
projects.proposed_solution: Develop an interactive GPS tracking map and student carpool coordination workspace with college-verified logins.

projects.title: Autonomous Campus Delivery Rover
projects.short_description: Self-driving four-wheeled rover navigating pedestrian walkways between Academic Blocks and Canteen.
projects.description: An autonomous ground vehicle (AGV) prototype utilizing ROS2, 2D LiDAR SLAM, and Depth Cameras to deliver lab components and stationery across campus walkways safely without colliding with pedestrians.
projects.problem_statement: Staff and student project labs frequently need rapid physical transport of hardware tools and printed circuit boards across distant campus wings during working hours.
projects.proposed_solution: Build a differential drive rover with waypoint navigation, ultrasonic obstacle detection, and live telemetry to automate short-distance campus deliveries.

projects.title: Alandi Water Quality Monitoring IoT Grid
projects.short_description: Solar-powered wireless sensor buoys monitoring Indrayani river water quality parameters in real time.
projects.description: A distributed environmental sensing network featuring floating buoys along the Indrayani river near Alandi temple ghat. Measures dissolved oxygen, turbidity, pH, and water temperature to publish open ecological telemetry.
projects.problem_statement: Pilgrimage seasons and industrial discharge result in rapid, undetected shifts in Indrayani water quality without actionable continuous public monitoring.
projects.proposed_solution: Deploy submersible multi-probe sensor pods transmitting telemetry over LoRaWAN to a campus dashboard with automated pollution threshold alerts.

projects.title: Contactless Smart Attendance & Face Recognition Gate
projects.short_description: Edge-computed classroom attendance system with infrared anti-spoofing liveness detection.
projects.description: A high-speed edge facial recognition platform that detects and logs student attendance within 300ms upon entering the classroom or lab, preventing buddy punching with infrared depth checks.
projects.problem_statement: Manual roll-calling consumes up to 10 minutes of every 60-minute lecture, and traditional fingerprint scanners cause entry bottlenecks.
projects.proposed_solution: Mount edge camera nodes with TensorRT optimized face embeddings paired with secure backend sync to the student management system.

projects.title: Peer Tutoring & Lecture Notes Knowledge Hub
projects.short_description: College-verified collaborative study network for mentoring juniors, past question papers, and lab code.
projects.description: A student-exclusive portal where high-performing seniors schedule 1-on-1 subject clarification sessions, exchange verified handwritten lecture notes, and share solved university question sets with peer upvoting.
projects.problem_statement: Academic resources and exam tips are fragmented across informal WhatsApp groups with no indexing, verification, or searchable taxonomy.
projects.proposed_solution: Create a clean, college-gated repository with syllabus-indexed units, PDF preview annotations, and a karma-based peer tutoring scheduler.

projects.title: Campus Solar Energy Forecast & Microgrid Dashboard
projects.short_description: Predictive power load forecasting and rooftop solar generation analytics for MIT AOE campus buildings.
projects.description: Analyzes energy consumption across computer centers, mechanical workshops, and hostel blocks against rooftop photovoltaic output to recommend smart load shifting and peak demand cutbacks.
projects.problem_statement: The campus incurs heavy peak utility tariffs because high-power laboratory machinery runs concurrently with peak solar drop-offs.
projects.proposed_solution: Train time-series gradient boosted models on weather and consumption telemetry to forecast day-ahead net power deficits.

projects.title: College Fest Ticketing & Rapid QR Access Pass
projects.short_description: Offline-capable mobile app for annual festival registration, flash hackathons, and gate badge scanning.
projects.description: A mobile passbook app designed to streamline thousands of student check-ins during technical symposiums and cultural fests, with encrypted offline QR verification and live attendee headcounts.
projects.problem_statement: Paper wristbands and manual gate spreadsheets cause hour-long entry queues and duplicate ticket pass-backs at annual events.
projects.proposed_solution: Provide time-synced dynamic QR codes that refresh every 30 seconds and can be validated offline by volunteer scanners.

projects.title: Campus Network Intrusion Honeypot & Threat Map
projects.short_description: Internal cybersecurity utility and simulated honeypot to detect rogue devices and analyze campus traffic.
projects.description: Deploys lightweight decoy network services (SSH, HTTP, SMB) within the college subnet to monitor unauthorized scan sweeps, credential brute-forcing, and rogue Wi-Fi AP intrusions.
projects.problem_statement: Open lab Wi-Fi networks are vulnerable to lateral movement by compromised personal student laptops and rogue access points.
projects.proposed_solution: Configure low-interaction honeypots with an automated alert pipeline that surfaces rogue port scans on a live administrative threat map.

projects.title: Automated Library Shelf Scanning & RFID Cart
projects.short_description: Mechatronic tabletop cart that scans RFID tags on library shelves and detects misplaced books.
projects.description: An automated shelf-traversing scanner with directional RFID antennas that reconciles book call numbers against the central library database, flagging misplaced books on a digital inventory map.
projects.problem_statement: Thousands of textbooks are misplaced daily by browsing students, rendering them virtually lost for weeks despite showing available in the catalog.
projects.proposed_solution: Build an automated rail-and-cart robot that glides along bookshelf aisles after hours to pinpoint the shelf location of every cataloged book.

projects.title: Bloom Taxonomy AI Exam & Rubrics Generator
projects.short_description: AI-assisted exam question paper compiler and grading rubrics evaluator for engineering curriculum.
projects.description: A domain-tuned application that parses university course syllabi and learning objectives to generate balanced question papers strictly mapped to Bloom cognitive levels (Remembering through Evaluating).
projects.problem_statement: Faculty spend extensive time drafting balanced mid-term and semester papers that satisfy NBA/NAAC accreditation rubrics.
projects.proposed_solution: Utilize Gemini API and LangChain with syllabus PDF retrieval to generate calibrated problem statements and numerical answer keys.

projects.title: Campus Emergency SOS & Medical Response Network
projects.short_description: Instant geotargeted emergency alert broadcast to campus security and ambulance with live GPS tracking.
projects.description: A life-safety mobile and web network that allows students in medical or security distress to broadcast an SOS alert with precise indoor room locations to campus security patrol and the medical infirmary.
projects.problem_statement: In sudden laboratory mishaps or medical emergencies, contacting guards across large multistory academic buildings is slow and lacks location clarity.
projects.proposed_solution: Create a one-tap panic button mobile application integrated with campus security dispatch monitors and Bluetooth beacon triangulation.

applications.introduction_message: I have designed interactive geospatial mapping interfaces in Leaflet and React for our college mobility hackathon. I would love to build the live commuter ETA view.
Experienced with Express.js and real-time WebSocket coordinate streaming. I want to build the low-latency bus GPS telemetry ingest pipeline.
I have researched solar irradiation models using Scikit-Learn and Pandas. Excited to deploy daily peak load forecasts for the campus microgrid.
Built high-throughput telemetry dashboards in React and Plotly. Can render real-time power production vs building load comparison charts.

Field Trial Notice: We received formal approval from the transport desk to mount our battery-powered GPS datalogger on Campus Shuttle Bus #2 this Friday at 4:30 PM. We will test live packet loss under tree canopies along the Alandi ghat.
Autonomous Rover Kickoff: Meeting Wednesday 5:00 PM at Mechatronics Lab (Block B). Please ensure your laptops have ROS2 Humble and Nav2 binaries installed before the session.
